compatibilityIssues: Migration from Web Forms to .NET 8 required
upgradeSteps: Refactor Web Forms to Razor Pages/MVC

issues.impact: All data access code must be rewritten. EF6 DbContext must be migrated to EF Core DbContext. Entity configurations using EntityTypeConfiguration<T> must be migrated to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Lazy loading behavior differs significantly.
issues.description: The application uses Entity Framework 6.2.0 which is a .NET Framework-only package and cannot be used in .NET 8. This is a complete blocker for migration.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 8.0.0, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer 8.0.0, and Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 8.0.0. All DbContext, entity configurations, LINQ queries, and migrations must be rewritten for EF Core.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6.2.0 is NOT compatible with .NET 8

issues.impact: All logging statements across 15+ files must be rewritten. LogManager.GetLogger() calls must be replaced with ILogger<T> injection. Log4Net.xml configuration file must be removed and migrated to appsettings.json or Serilog configuration.
issues.description: The application uses log4net which is a legacy logging framework not optimized for .NET 8 and ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Replace with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging 8.0.0 and Serilog.AspNetCore 8.0.0. Replace all ILog references with ILogger<T>. Configure logging in Program.cs using builder.Logging or Serilog.
issues.title: log4net 2.0.10 is legacy and not recommended for .NET 8

issues.impact: All System.Web.UI.Page base classes, HttpContext.Current usages, Session state, ViewState, Postback patterns, and Server controls must be completely refactored for ASP.NET Core.
issues.description: The project references System.Web which is a .NET Framework-only assembly and does not exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove System.Web reference entirely. Replace with ASP.NET Core equivalents: IHttpContextAccessor for HttpContext.Current, IWebHostEnvironment for Server.MapPath, IMemoryCache or IDistributedCache for Cache, TempData for Session where needed.
issues.title: System.Web dependency - not available in .NET 8

issues.impact: All 7 .aspx pages and their code-behind files must be completely rewritten as Razor Pages. Page lifecycle events (Page_Load, Page_PreRender, etc.) must be replaced with OnGet/OnPost handlers.
issues.description: All page code-behind files inherit from System.Web.UI.Page which doesn't exist in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Razor Pages with PageModel base class. Pages must be rewritten as .cshtml files with PageModel code-behind inheriting from Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages.PageModel.
issues.title: System.Web.UI.Page base class incompatible

issues.impact: Application startup logic, routing configuration, bundle configuration, DI container setup, and request pipeline configuration must all be migrated to Program.cs and middleware.
issues.description: Global.asax and HttpApplication are .NET Framework Web Forms patterns that don't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Migrate Application_Start to Program.cs configuration. Migrate Application_BeginRequest to ASP.NET Core middleware. Session initialization must be handled differently using session middleware configuration.
issues.title: Global.asax application lifecycle - incompatible pattern

issues.impact: IContainerProviderAccessor pattern must be removed. Property injection pattern must be replaced with constructor injection. Application-level container configuration must be migrated to Program.cs.
issues.description: Autofac.Integration.Web (version 4.0.0) is designed for Web Forms and incompatible with ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use built-in ASP.NET Core dependency injection or Autofac.Extensions.DependencyInjection 8.0.0 for ASP.NET Core. Register services in Program.cs using builder.Services or builder.Host.UseServiceProviderFactory().
issues.title: Autofac Web Forms integration incompatible

issues.impact: All configuration must be migrated: connection strings (line 11-13), app settings (lines 14-17), compilation settings, sessionState mode, httpModules, and entityFramework sections. ConfigurationManager.AppSettings and ConfigurationManager.ConnectionStrings calls must be replaced with IConfiguration.
issues.description: Web.config is the .NET Framework configuration system and is not used in .NET 8 ASP.NET Core applications.
issues.recommendation: Create appsettings.json and appsettings.Development.json files. Migrate connectionStrings, appSettings, and system.web sections to JSON format. Use IConfiguration and Options pattern for accessing settings.
issues.title: Web.config configuration system incompatible

issues.impact: BundleConfig.cs and Bundle.config must be removed. Script and style bundle references in master pages must be replaced with standard link and script tags or modern bundling solutions.
issues.description: Web Forms-specific bundling and optimization package not compatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove and replace with ASP.NET Core bundling solutions like WebOptimizer, or use modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite, etc.). Static files should be served from wwwroot folder.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.Web.Optimization.WebForms incompatible

issues.impact: All AJAX functionality dependent on ScriptManager must be reimplemented. UpdatePanel controls (if any) must be replaced with partial views and AJAX calls.
issues.description: ASP.NET AJAX ScriptManager control used in master page is Web Forms-specific and not available in .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Remove ScriptManager. Use standard HTML <script> tags in _Layout.cshtml. Implement client-side functionality using modern JavaScript libraries and frameworks.
issues.title: ScriptManager control incompatible

issues.impact: Site.Master and Site.Mobile.Master must be converted to Razor layouts. MasterPage base class and ContentPlaceHolder pattern must be replaced with Razor layout conventions.
issues.description: Master pages (.master files) are Web Forms-specific and must be replaced with Razor Layout pages.
issues.recommendation: Convert to Razor Layout page (_Layout.cshtml). ContentPlaceHolder controls become @RenderBody() or named sections with @RenderSection(). Remove runat="server" form tag.
issues.title: Master page pattern incompatible

issues.impact: ContainerDisposal, PropertyInjection, TelemetryCorrelation, and ApplicationInsights HTTP modules must be reimplemented as middleware or replaced with ASP.NET Core equivalents.
issues.description: HTTP Modules defined in Web.config are .NET Framework-specific and must be replaced with middleware.
issues.recommendation: Replace all HTTP modules with ASP.NET Core middleware. Implement custom middleware classes and register in Program.cs using app.UseMiddleware<T>(). Autofac modules should use standard DI scopes.
issues.title: HTTP Modules incompatible

issues.impact: DbContext initialization pattern must change. OnModelCreating must be updated for EF Core. EntityTypeConfiguration<T> must be changed to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>. Database initializers must be replaced with migrations.
issues.description: CatalogDBContext inherits from System.Data.Entity.DbContext which is Entity Framework 6 and incompatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Change to inherit from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext. Update constructor to accept DbContextOptions<CatalogDBContext>. Migrate entity configurations to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>.
issues.title: System.Data.Entity DbContext incompatible

issues.impact: All three entity configuration methods (ConfigureCatalogType, ConfigureCatalogBrand, ConfigureCatalogItem) must be converted to IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> implementations.
issues.description: EntityTypeConfiguration<T> class used for entity configuration is EF6-specific and doesn't exist in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Implement IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> in separate configuration classes. Use builder.Entity<T>() in OnModelCreating to apply configurations.
issues.title: Entity Framework 6 EntityTypeConfiguration incompatible

issues.impact: Both foreign key relationships (CatalogBrand and CatalogType) on lines 79-85 must be updated to EF Core syntax.
issues.description: HasRequired<T>() and WithMany() methods have different syntax in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Use EF Core relationship API: builder.HasOne(ci => ci.CatalogBrand).WithMany().HasForeignKey(ci => ci.CatalogBrandId). Required relationships are configured via OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Restrict).
issues.title: EF6 HasRequired/WithMany relationship configuration incompatible

issues.impact: CatalogDBInitializer class must be removed and replaced with EF Core migration-based approach. Database seeding logic must be migrated to EF Core seed data mechanism.
issues.description: Database.SetInitializer<T> is an EF6 pattern for database initialization that doesn't exist in EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Use EF Core migrations instead. Create initial migration, configure in Program.cs using context.Database.Migrate() or context.Database.EnsureCreated() for development. Seed data should be in migration or OnModelCreatingFinished.
issues.title: Database.SetInitializer pattern incompatible

issues.impact: All 7+ files using log4net must be updated. Each class needs constructor injection of ILogger<T>. All _log method calls must be updated to ILogger API.
issues.description: Static LogManager.GetLogger() pattern is used throughout the application which doesn't align with .NET 8 dependency injection.
issues.recommendation: Inject ILogger<T> via constructor dependency injection. Replace ILog with ILogger<T>. Update logging statements to use structured logging with interpolation.
issues.title: log4net LogManager incompatible with ILogger pattern

issues.impact: Session_Start logic must be replaced with middleware or filters. Session state must be configured in Program.cs. All session access patterns must be updated.
issues.description: HttpContext.Current.Session is used in Global.asax which is incompatible with ASP.NET Core session management.
issues.recommendation: Configure session middleware in Program.cs. Use HttpContext.Session (without .Current) via IHttpContextAccessor. Consider stateless design or distributed cache for scalability.
issues.title: Session state usage incompatible

issues.codeSnippet: protected void Page_Load(object sender, EventArgs e)
issues.impact: All Page_Load methods across 7 pages must be converted to OnGet handlers. Event sender/EventArgs pattern is removed. ViewState-dependent logic must be refactored.
issues.description: Page_Load events are Web Forms-specific lifecycle events that don't exist in Razor Pages.
issues.recommendation: Replace with OnGet/OnGetAsync handler methods in PageModel. Initialize data in handler methods. Use [FromQuery] or [FromRoute] attributes for parameters.
issues.title: Page lifecycle events incompatible

issues.impact: Route parameter access in Default.aspx.cs (lines 26-27) must be converted to method parameters with [FromRoute] attributes.
issues.description: Page.RouteData.Values pattern for accessing route parameters differs in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use [FromRoute] or [FromQuery] parameter binding in OnGet handler methods. Parameters are automatically bound and type-converted.
issues.title: RouteData.Values access pattern incompatible

issues.impact: All server control data binding must be replaced with Razor syntax. ListView, GridView, DropDownList controls must be replaced with HTML and Razor.
issues.description: DataSource and DataBind() pattern for server controls doesn't exist in Razor Pages.
issues.recommendation: Use Razor syntax for rendering collections: @foreach loops or Tag Helpers. Pass data via PageModel properties and render in .cshtml view.
issues.title: Server control data binding incompatible

issues.impact: All Response.Redirect calls must be updated to return RedirectToPage or similar. Handler methods must return IActionResult instead of void.
issues.description: Response.Redirect works differently in ASP.NET Core and should be replaced with RedirectToPage.
issues.recommendation: Use return RedirectToPage("/Index") or RedirectToAction for MVC. PageModel handlers should return IActionResult.
issues.title: Response.Redirect usage requires updates

issues.impact: All Web Forms validation controls must be replaced with data annotations, tag helpers for validation, and client-side validation using jQuery Unobtrusive Validation.
issues.description: this.ModelState.IsValid pattern exists but server control validation differs from ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Continue using ModelState.IsValid in PageModel, but validation is now based on data annotations and FluentValidation. Server control validators must be replaced with validation attributes.
issues.title: ModelState validation pattern differences

issues.impact: All 7 pages using property injection must be converted to constructor injection. Remove Autofac.Integration.Web property injection module.
issues.description: Public property injection of ICatalogService is Web Forms/Autofac.Web-specific and incompatible with ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use constructor injection in PageModel. Inject ICatalogService via constructor parameter. ASP.NET Core DI container does not support property injection by default.
issues.title: Property injection pattern incompatible

issues.codeSnippet: PaginationNext.NavigateUrl = GetRouteUrl("ProductsByPageRoute", new { index = Model.ActualPage + 1, size = Model.ItemsPerPage });
issues.impact: URL generation logic for pagination links must be updated. Named routes must be defined using [Route] attributes or endpoint routing.
issues.description: Page.GetRouteUrl() for generating route URLs works differently in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Use Url.PageLink() or Tag Helpers (asp-page, asp-route-*) in Razor Pages for link generation. IUrlHelper is injected automatically in PageModel.
issues.title: GetRouteUrl method incompatible

issues.impact: All HyperLink controls must be replaced with HTML anchor tags. NavigateUrl property assignments must be replaced with href attributes using Tag Helpers.
issues.description: asp:HyperLink server controls don't exist in Razor Pages and must be replaced with standard HTML.
issues.recommendation: Replace with standard <a> tags using Razor syntax and Tag Helpers. Use asp-page and asp-route-* attributes for link generation.
issues.title: HyperLink server control incompatible

issues.impact: FriendlyUrls route configuration must be removed and replaced with standard ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.description: FriendlyUrls package is Web Forms-specific and not compatible with ASP.NET Core routing.
issues.recommendation: Remove package. Use ASP.NET Core endpoint routing and route constraints. Define routes using [Route] attributes or endpoint configuration in Program.cs.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.FriendlyUrls incompatible

issues.impact: Session configuration must be migrated to ASP.NET Core session middleware. InProc session mode must be evaluated for cloud/scale-out scenarios.
issues.description: Web Forms async session state module not compatible with ASP.NET Core session.
issues.recommendation: Remove package. Configure ASP.NET Core session middleware using builder.Services.AddSession() and app.UseSession(). Consider distributed session for scalability.
issues.title: Microsoft.AspNet.SessionState.SessionStateModule incompatible

issues.impact: ApplicationModule class must be converted to extension method. All Autofac-specific registrations must be converted to Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection syntax.
issues.description: Autofac module registration pattern needs migration to ASP.NET Core DI.
issues.recommendation: Convert ApplicationModule to extension method on IServiceCollection. Register services using builder.Services.AddScoped/AddTransient/AddSingleton in Program.cs.
issues.title: ApplicationModule DI registration pattern

issues.impact: Entire .csproj file must be converted from legacy format to SDK-style. Remove unnecessary elements like ToolsVersion, ProjectTypeGuids, Reference elements for framework assemblies.
issues.description: Project targets .NET Framework 4.7.2 which is incompatible with .NET 8 migration.
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style project file with <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>. Use <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web"> format.
issues.title: TargetFrameworkVersion 4.7.2 must be changed to net8.0

issues.impact: ApplicationInsights.config must be removed. HTTP modules for Application Insights must be removed. Telemetry configuration must be migrated to code-based configuration.
issues.description: Microsoft.ApplicationInsights version 2.9.1 is old and should be updated for .NET 8 compatibility.
issues.recommendation: Update to Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore 2.21.0 or later for ASP.NET Core. Configure in Program.cs using builder.Services.AddApplicationInsightsTelemetry().
issues.title: ApplicationInsights packages may need updates

issues.impact: ViewSwitcher.ascx and ViewSwitcher.ascx.cs must be converted. May need mobile/desktop detection logic refactoring for modern responsive design.
issues.description: ViewSwitcher.ascx user control is Web Forms-specific and must be converted to View Component or Partial View.
issues.recommendation: Convert to View Component for complex logic or Partial View for simple rendering. User control code-behind must be converted to View Component class or integrated into parent page.
issues.title: User control (.ascx) incompatible

issues.impact: BundleConfig.cs must be removed. Bundle references in master pages must be replaced with direct link/script tags or modern bundling solution.
issues.description: BundleConfig.RegisterBundles is Web Forms-specific bundling that doesn't apply to ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove BundleConfig. Use WebOptimizer package, or modern build tools (npm, webpack, Vite) for asset bundling. Serve static files from wwwroot.
issues.title: Bundle configuration pattern incompatible

issues.impact: RouteConfig.cs must be removed and routes must be defined using ASP.NET Core conventions or attributes.
issues.description: Web Forms routing configuration must be migrated to ASP.NET Core endpoint routing.
issues.recommendation: Remove RouteConfig. Use endpoint routing in Program.cs with app.MapRazorPages() or app.MapControllers(). Define routes using [Route] attributes.
issues.title: RouteConfig.RegisterRoutes pattern incompatible

issues.impact: All methods in CatalogService (lines 22-69) must be converted to async. ICatalogService interface must be updated. All calling code in pages must be updated to await async calls.
issues.description: CatalogService uses synchronous EF operations which is not recommended for .NET 8 web applications.
issues.recommendation: Convert all database operations to async/await pattern. Use ToListAsync(), FirstOrDefaultAsync(), LongCountAsync(), SaveChangesAsync(). Add CancellationToken parameters.
issues.title: Synchronous database operations should be async

issues.impact: IDisposable implementation can be removed from CatalogService. DbContext is registered as scoped and disposed automatically by DI container.
issues.description: Explicit Dispose() method on service is not the recommended pattern for ASP.NET Core with DI.
issues.recommendation: Remove explicit Dispose. Register DbContext with scoped lifetime using builder.Services.AddDbContext(). DI container handles disposal automatically.
issues.title: DbContext disposal pattern differs

issues.impact: Complete project file rewrite required. Must remove 300+ lines of explicit file references. Must update to PackageReference from packages.config.
issues.description: Project uses legacy .csproj format with explicit file includes which is verbose and incompatible with .NET 8.
issues.recommendation: Convert to SDK-style project using <Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web">. Remove explicit Content includes (lines 191-315), Compile includes (lines 318-405). SDK-style projects include files by convention.
issues.title: Legacy project file format

issues.impact: Request validation is built-in to ASP.NET Core. Ensure all forms use antiforgery tokens with [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] or automatic validation.
issues.description: requestValidationMode="2.0" is Web Forms-specific configuration that doesn't exist in ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove configuration. ASP.NET Core has automatic request validation and antiforgery token validation. Configure antiforgery options in Program.cs if needed.
issues.title: Request validation mode incompatible

issues.impact: Can be removed or updated. Check if any JavaScript depends on Modernizr feature detection.
issues.description: Modernizr 2.8.3 is very old and may not be needed with modern browsers.
issues.recommendation: Evaluate if Modernizr is still needed for browser feature detection. Modern browsers support most features. If needed, update to latest version or use CDN.
issues.title: Modernizr may need updating

issues.impact: Can be safely removed. Update master page to remove respond.js script reference.
issues.description: Respond.js 1.4.2 is for IE8 CSS3 media query support which is no longer needed.
issues.recommendation: Remove package. Modern browsers (including supported IE11) have native media query support. This library is obsolete.
issues.title: Respond.js may not be needed

issues.impact: If TypeScript is used, set up modern TypeScript build pipeline with npm/Node.js. Output compiled JS to wwwroot.
issues.description: TypeScript compilation is configured for Visual Studio integration which differs in .NET 8 projects.
issues.recommendation: Remove TypeScript MSBuild integration. Use npm and modern TypeScript tooling. Configure tsconfig.json for TypeScript compilation.
issues.title: TypeScript compilation may need reconfiguration

issues.impact: Will be removed as part of Web Optimization package removal.
issues.description: Antlr 3.5.0.2 is likely a transitive dependency and may not be directly needed.
issues.recommendation: This is likely a dependency of Web Optimization. When removing bundling, this dependency will be removed automatically.
issues.title: Antlr3 may not be needed

issues.impact: Removed as part of bundling migration strategy.
issues.description: WebGrease 1.6.0 is a dependency of Web Optimization for CSS/JS minification.
issues.recommendation: Will be removed with Web Optimization package. Use modern build tools or WebOptimizer for minification.
issues.title: WebGrease may not be needed

issues.impact: MainContent ContentPlaceHolder must become @RenderBody() in _Layout.cshtml.
issues.description: Master page ContentPlaceHolder controls must be converted to Razor layout sections.
issues.recommendation: Convert to @RenderBody() for main content area. Named content areas become @RenderSection("SectionName", required: false).
issues.title: ContentPlaceHolder pattern needs migration

issues.impact: Remove form tag from layout. Add individual forms in pages where POST operations are needed. Use antiforgery token with form tag helper.
issues.description: The runat="server" form tag wrapping the entire page is Web Forms-specific and incompatible with ASP.NET Core.
issues.recommendation: Remove server-side form tag from layout. Use standard HTML <form> tags with asp-page/asp-action attributes only where needed for specific operations.
issues.title: Server-side form tag incompatible

issues.impact: All server controls in master pages and .aspx pages must be replaced with HTML and Razor syntax. This affects layout, forms, and data display.
issues.description: All server controls (asp:Label, asp:HyperLink, etc.) with runat="server" must be replaced with standard HTML.
issues.recommendation: Replace with standard HTML or Razor syntax. asp:Label becomes @Model.Property or
issues.title: Server controls with runat="server" incompatible

issues.impact: Optional architectural improvement. Would provide better testability and separation of concerns as per clean architecture principles in the rules file.
issues.description: CatalogService directly uses DbContext which couples it to EF Core. Consider repository pattern for better abstraction.
issues.recommendation: Consider implementing repository pattern for better separation. Create ICatalogItemRepository, ICatalogBrandRepository, ICatalogTypeRepository interfaces and implementations in Infrastructure layer.
issues.title: Direct DbContext injection in service layer

issues.impact: HiLo generator must be updated for EF Core. Consider using EF Core's native sequence support or identity columns instead.
issues.description: CatalogItemHiLoGenerator uses EF6 patterns for sequence generation that need updating for EF Core.
issues.recommendation: Update to use EF Core's FromSqlRaw for sequence queries. Or consider using EF Core's built-in sequence support with HasSequence() in model configuration.
issues.title: HiLo sequence generator pattern needs EF Core migration

recommendations: Migrate Entity Framework 6 to EF Core 8 first. This is the foundation for all data access. Create new DbContext inheriting from Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbContext, implement IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> for all entities, create initial migration, and test all data access operations.

Replace log4net with Microsoft.Extensions.Logging and Serilog. Update all 7+ files using ILog to use ILogger<T> with constructor injection. Configure logging in Program.cs. This must be done early as it affects all layers.

Convert to SDK-style project file targeting net8.0. Create clean architecture solution structure with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and Web projects as specified in upgrade rules. This provides the foundation for all other migrations.

Migrate Web.config to appsettings.json. Move connection strings, app settings, and other configuration to JSON format. Implement Options pattern for strongly-typed configuration access. Configure services in Program.cs.

Migrate from Autofac Web Forms integration to ASP.NET Core built-in DI. Convert ApplicationModule to extension methods on IServiceCollection. Replace property injection with constructor injection throughout. Register all services in Program.cs.

Convert all 7 .aspx pages to Razor Pages. Create PageModel classes, migrate Page_Load to OnGet handlers, replace server controls with HTML and Tag Helpers, implement proper form handling with OnPost handlers. Start with simplest pages (About, Contact) then progress to complex pages (Default, Catalog CRUD).

Convert master pages (Site.Master, Site.Mobile.Master) to Razor layouts (_Layout.cshtml). Remove ScriptManager, replace ContentPlaceHolder with @RenderBody(), convert server controls to HTML, implement responsive design instead of mobile master page.
Convert ViewSwitcher user control to View Component or remove in favor of responsive design. Evaluate if mobile detection is still needed with modern responsive CSS frameworks.

Update CatalogService to use async/await patterns. Convert all database operations to async (ToListAsync, SaveChangesAsync, etc.). Add CancellationToken parameters. Consider implementing repository pattern for better abstraction as per clean architecture rules.

Migrate Global.asax logic to Program.cs. Move routing configuration to endpoint routing, replace HTTP modules with middleware, handle session initialization with middleware, configure all services and middleware in proper order.

Remove Web Optimization and bundles. Move static files to wwwroot folder. Implement modern bundling with WebOptimizer or use build tools (npm, webpack). Update all script and style references in layouts.

Configure ASP.NET Core session middleware. Evaluate if session is truly needed or can be replaced with stateless design. For session usage, implement distributed cache for scalability. Migrate Session_Start logic to middleware or application code.
Create unit test and integration test projects as specified in upgrade rules. Test all data access, business logic, and page functionality. Ensure migration maintains existing functionality.

Ensure antiforgery token validation is enabled for all POST operations. Review authentication/authorization if implemented. Validate all user inputs. Enable HTTPS. Review error handling to avoid information disclosure.

Update all compatible packages to latest versions. Update ApplicationInsights to AspNetCore version. Update Newtonsoft.Json if needed or consider System.Text.Json. Update Bootstrap and jQuery to latest versions. Remove obsolete packages (Modernizr, Respond.js).

Create migration documentation as specified in upgrade rules: README.md, MIGRATION_NOTES.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, BUILD_VERIFICATION.md. Document all changes, breaking changes, configuration requirements, and deployment instructions.
